title: Frequency-dependent interaural dispersion does not establish incremental tinnitus prediction across NHANES samples
abstract: In 1726 complete-case NHANES 2003–2004 adults aged 20–69, frequency-dependent interaural dispersion did not establish improved past-year tinnitus prediction beyond conventional hearing summaries and risk factors: weighted Brier gain +0.00015277, source/target PSU-refit 95% interval -0.00682683 to +0.00212107.
